title: Images of open sets under C¹ maps ℝⁿ → ℝ^Q are countably n-rectifiable
statement: For all Q, n ∈ ℕ, every map G : ℝⁿ → ℝ^Q and every open O ⊆ ℝⁿ such that G is C¹ on O, the image G(O) is countably n-rectifiable.
lean_statement: ∀ (Q n : ℕ) (G : Eucl n → Eucl Q) (O : Set (Eucl n)), IsOpen O → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 G O → CountablyRectifiable n (G '' O)
